title: Zillow listing agents run records
description: Default key-value store with the listings collected on the run, the run summary, and the resume checkpoint.

listings.title: Listings
listings.description: Listings collected on this run, with the run counts.

summary.title: Summary
summary.description: listings_found, agents_found, agents_enriched, and blocked_zips for the finished run.

checkpoint.title: Checkpoint
checkpoint.description: Search position, pending listing URLs, and agents already kept. A migrated or restarted run resumes from this record.
